sourceHeader.keywords: Hijutsu, Ninjutsu, Fuinjutsu, Lightning Release, Efficient, Stable

system.description:
You release a pulse of Data Release from yourself which can causes a construct formed of neon light to materialize and fight alongside you in a shape or design of your choice named the Neon Antivirus. You can command this creature as a bonus action on your turn.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3. If this jutsu is cast at B-Rank or higher, you can summon and command up to two Neon Antivirus. The second Neon Antivirus is always using the effects of the opposite Link you aren’t utilizing. If you are not using a Link, then it gains no link effects.
